name: arcane-checkers
description: Arcane Checkers — static web game with optional Capacitor native wrap

scripts.cap:init: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/ios @capacitor/android @capacitor/splash-screen && npx cap init "Arcane Checkers" com.example.arcanecheckers --web-dir . && cp mobile/capacitor.config.example.json capacitor.config.json
